beats.text: The villain is the re-prefill. It’s like forcing a marathon runner to stop and re-tie their shoes every single mile.

beats.text: Enter AKV. It performs live surgery on your KV cache tensors, bypassing the need to re-process stale history.

feynman_certification.listener_verdict: The hook was solid—I've definitely dealt with the pain of context window bloat, so calling out the re-prefill bottleneck immediately got me. I like that you didn't use 'smart AI tools' or other cringe marketing speak. My only hang-up is in Beat 4; 'patching attention masks' sounds cool, but I'm not 100% sure how you're handling the KV cache eviction without breaking the causal masking or the positional encoding logic. It's a bit of a 'trust me bro' moment on the implementation details.

thriller_metadata.paradigm_shift: Direct stateful manipulation of KV cache tensors without re-computation.
